title: Extended figure — Signed raw disruption distributions (Stage 2)
description: Inverse-inclusion-weighted empirical CDF of signed raw D for one, ten and 51–100 authors (600, 624 and 477 Columbia OpenAlex works with a unique postpublication citer through 23 November 2026). Display range is −0.1 to 0.1 on a symmetric log scale; zero is the sign boundary between development (negative) and disruption (positive). Pointwise 95% percentile bootstrap bands use 1,000 within-original-stratum focal-work replacement draws with no finite-population correction, including the 51–100 stratum. The raw score for most works is close to zero; the curves differ around zero.

reviews.summary: The weighted CDFs support C2 for the three displayed team sizes: the share of works with negative or zero disruption scores differs clearly across groups, a comparison that means alone do not show. The caption states the restricted display range and identifies the intervals as pointwise bootstrap bands, with no finite-population correction even for the fully sampled stratum.

issues.problem: The phrase “with a unique postpublication citer” could be read as restricting the sample to works with exactly one citer.
issues.fix: Say “with at least one distinct citing work in the postpublication window ending 23 November 2026.”
